idea-plugin.name: Local Secrets Tripwire
idea-plugin.description:
Local Secrets Tripwire

Leaked secrets are the #1 cause of security breaches. Local Secrets Tripwire scans your files in real time for API keys, tokens, passwords, and private keys — catching them before they're committed to version control.

Key Features

  • Real-Time Scanning — Detects secrets as you type with inline editor warnings
  • Pattern Matching — Recognizes AWS keys, GitHub tokens, private keys, JWTs, and 30+ patterns
  • Entropy Analysis — Shannon entropy detection for high-randomness strings that may be secrets
  • Gutter Warnings — Visual indicators for lines containing potential secrets
  • Allowlist Support — Configure .secrets-allowlist for known false positives
  • Custom Patterns — Add organization-specific secret patterns and thresholds

Why Local Secrets Tripwire?

Git hooks catch secrets at commit time — this plugin catches them at typing time. No external services, no network calls, zero secrets leave your machine.

Free vs Pro

  • Free: All core features — pattern matching, entropy analysis, gutter warnings, allowlist, custom patterns
  • Pro: Pre-commit hook integration, secret rotation reminders, team pattern sharing, compliance audit logs, and historical scan reports
